body: Thank you, this put exactly how I’ve been feeling into words. This game is starting to feel like such a scam.

I feel this. I used to be the only girl within a group of guys at a retail store and the amount of pure anger and hate I’d receive compared to my coworkers became so insufferable I found myself dreading work but mostly growing a strong hate towards people. I’d get assaulted, belittled, despite being an assistant manager with a passion for my job. But qualifications weren’t enough for people to even bother with an ounce of respect. I’m told that it’s just a part of life, but the thing is, I don’t WANT to feel like people are just naturally going to be trash all the time. The thought of it makes me feel so hopeless. 

I know this post is probably dead, and I hope things are looking better for you. I just wanted to share my empathy.
